title: Added method Team.train to level up one member

traceDiagram.title: Train team member flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how [`Team.train()` reads the Pokemon at one slot of the team](code:src/pokedex/team.py#L21), and how [`Pokemon.level_up()` returns a copy of that Pokemon one level higher](code:src/pokedex/models.py#L13). `main()` of the `pokedex` command reaches both through [`team.train(0)`](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L15).

traceNodes.label: Holds the Pokemon of one trainer and counts the training sessions
traceNodes.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, [`build_starter_team()` makes a team for Ash](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L7). Then [`main()` calls `train(0)` on that team](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L15).

children.label: Levels up the Pokemon at one slot and puts the copy back
children.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, [`main()` calls this method with the slot `0`](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L15). Slot `0` holds Pikachu, because [`build_starter_team()` adds Pikachu first](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L8).

blockLabels.label: Calls pokemon.level_up to make a copy of the Pokemon one level higher
Returns the Pokemon one level higher
Starts the count of training sessions at `0`

traceNodes.label: Describes one Pokemon by its name, types and level
traceNodes.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, [`build_starter_team()` makes Pikachu and Bulbasaur](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L8-9) with this class. Then [`Team.train()` calls `level_up()` on Pikachu](code:src/pokedex/team.py#L22).

children.label: Returns a copy one level higher, at most level 100
children.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, `main()` calls `team.train(0)`. Then [`Team.train()` calls this method](code:src/pokedex/team.py#L22) on the Pokemon at slot `0`.

blockLabels.label: Returns a copy of the Pokemon one level higher, at most level 100

traceDiagram.title: Run pokedex command flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `main()` [builds a starter team for Ash](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L14) and [prints that team](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L16). It also shows what happens when a user runs the `pokedex` command, and how the first Pokemon of the team reaches `Pokemon.level_up()` through [`Team.train()`](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L15).

traceNodes.label: Builds the starter team, trains one member and prints the team
traceNodes.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, Python calls this function, because `[project.scripts]` of `pyproject.toml` names `pokedex.cli:main`. [Running the module as a script calls it too](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L19-20).

blockLabels.label: Calls build_starter_team to make the team of Ash
Calls team.train to level up the Pokemon at the first slot
Calls describe_team to write the team for printing

traceNodes.label: Makes the team of Ash with Pikachu and Bulbasaur
traceNodes.description: When a user runs the `pokedex` command, [`main()` calls this function first](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L14).

blockLabels.label: Calls Team to make the team for Ash

Calls team.add to put Pikachu in the team
Calls Pokemon to make an electric Pikachu
Calls team.add to put Bulbasaur in the team
Calls Pokemon to make a grass and poison Bulbasaur
Returns the team with Pikachu and Bulbasaur
